sites.name: Rach Gam - Xoai Mut Victory Monument
sites.event: The site marking the glorious victory of the peasant hero Nguyen Hue, who defeated 50,000 invading Siamese troops (in 1785).

sites.name: Vinh Trang Pagoda
sites.event: The largest pagoda in Tien Giang, outstanding for its unique architectural blend of East and West (French, Roman, Khmer, Chinese, and Vietnamese).

sites.name: Thoi Son Islet (Lan Islet)
sites.event: A famous orchard eco-tourism destination where visitors can experience riding in a three-plank sampan, listening to don ca tai tu, and enjoying fresh fruits right in the orchard.

sites.name: Dong Tam Snake Farm
sites.event: The largest center for snake breeding, research, medicinal herb processing, and snakebite emergency treatment in Vietnam, known as the 'Kingdom of Snakes'.

sites.name: Cai Be Floating Market
sites.event: One of the busiest and oldest floating markets in the Southwestern region, a place for trading agricultural products on the water (bordering the three provinces of Tien Giang, Vinh Long, and Ben Tre).

sites.name: Ap Bac Victory Relic Site
sites.event: The site of the historic battle (02/01/1963) that defeated the 'heliborne' and 'armored carrier' tactics of the US-puppet regime.

sites.name: Tan Thanh Beach (Go Cong Beach)
sites.event: A unique 7km-long black sand beach, famous for clam farming and seafood dishes (especially Go Cong clams).

sites.name: Truc Lam Chanh Giac Zen Monastery
sites.event: The largest Zen monastery in the region, famous for its Great Enlightenment Tower modeled after the Mahabodhi Temple in India.

sites.name: Royal Mausoleum
sites.event: The tomb and temple complex of the Pham Dang clan, including the tomb of Pham Dang Hung - the maternal grandfather of King Tu Duc (father of Empress Dowager Tu Du).

sites.name: Doc Phu Hai House
sites.event: An ancient house with an exquisite blend of Eastern and Western architecture, which has served as the setting for many famous movies (such as 'The Prince of Bac Lieu').

sites.name: Man Dinh Hong Flower Garden
sites.event: A vast flower garden with a wide variety of flowers, a famous check-in spot for young people in Tien Giang.

sites.name: Tan Dong Communal House (Go Tao Communal House)
sites.event: A unique ancient communal house 'embraced' by two ancient bodhi trees growing on its roof, creating a mysterious and sacred beauty.
